description: Puts a partner-created client on an agency-billed plan, or stops it when plan is null. Requires the agency owner who is also a client admin; starting a plan needs accepted terms and a ready collection method. Stopping parks the client service, which detaches its phone numbers from the voice agent under the existing parking policy.

plan.description: A partner plan key, or null to stop the client plan.

name: agency_billing_set_plan
title: Set Client Partner Plan
